description: A squat jar of sauce the colour of old brick, thick enough to stand a spoon in. The label is a strip of tape with MALCOLM'S on it in marker, and under it, smaller, in the same hand: it's fine. Apple butter, chipotle behind it, and a warmth that arrives four seconds late.
name: Malcolm's apple butter burn

tags.description: A squat jar of sauce the colour of old brick, thick enough to stand a spoon in. The label is a strip of tape with MALCOLM'S on it in marker, and underneath, smaller, in the same hand: it's fine. Apple butter underneath, chipotle somewhere behind it, and a warmth that arrives about four seconds after you think you got away with it.
